adjudicated.jp: 時間をかけて生きる癖をつけないといけない。
adjudicated.en: It is indispensable to grow into the habit, however bad, of living while expending time.
comments: This has nothing to do with wasting it, best seen in the ending. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: Taichi says that he must get used to taking time to live. The English calls the habit bad and recasts living patiently as expending time.

adjudicated.jp: 蝉も鳴かない世界だが、どこかに誰かがいる。
adjudicated.en: Even in this world where not even the cicadas cry somewhere, someone, must be among us.
comments: Renewing the idea that his messages also don't literally cross the barrier between worlds. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The Japanese contrasts a world where even cicadas are silent with the fact that somebody exists somewhere. The English misattaches 'somewhere' to the cicadas and produces an ungrammatical claim that somebody must be among the narrator's group.
adjudicated.remedy: Though not even cicadas sing in this world, somebody is out there somewhere.
